scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
Ahh . Brothers ! Does the task of
caring for out lost sheep burden
and tire you ?
I am here to assist you.
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
啊...兄弟們！
照顧迷失的羊群，是否讓你們感到疲憊不堪？
我在這裡協助你們。

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
Our members of the clergy
naturally learn a skill as
as they mature. As they approach 
their senior years as an acolyte
this special skill.
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
教會的成員在成長過程中自然會習得一項技能。
當他們接近服事的高階階段時，便會掌握這項特殊技能。

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
Faced with great danger and
an endless struggle with evil,
our brethren are much in need of assistance.
^3355FF' Holy Light '^000000 is that skill.
To gain this ability for yourself,
takes some work.
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
面對巨大的危險以及與邪惡無盡的鬥爭，我們的兄弟們急需援助。
^3355FF“神聖之光”^000000便是這項技能。
要獲得這項能力，需要付出一些努力。

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
To gain the skill, you must find these items.
^FF33551 Opal^000000
^FF33551 Crystal Blue^000000
^FF33551 Rosary^000000
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
要獲得這項技能，你必須找到這些物品。
^FF33551個蛋白石^000000
^FF33551個水靈礦石^000000
^FF33551個念珠^000000

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
In order to be able to even use this skill,
one must be have sufficient experience.
^FF3355 Job Level 30^000000
is required to learn this skill.
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
為了能夠使用這項技能，必須擁有足夠的經驗。
需要達到 ^FF3355 職業等級 30^000000才能學習這項技能。

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
As for a priest, because of their
already vast amount of experience,
they are able to gain this skill at any
job level.
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
至於牧師，由於他們已經擁有豐富的經驗，因此可以在任何職業等級獲得這項技能。

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
Brother, you already possess
the skill of ` Holy Light '.
You cannot gain a skill you
already possess ..
I pray that you are using
this skill for the work of good . .
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
兄弟，你已經擁有“神聖之光” 這項技能了。
你不能獲得你已經擁有的技能...
我祈禱你將這項技能用於行善之事...

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
Your faith has proven worthy
for you to gain the ' Holy Light ' skill.
Your skill is adequate
to use this skill.
Use it wisely. . .
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
你的信仰證明了你有資格獲得 “神聖之光” 技能。
你的技能水平足以使用這項技能。
請明智地使用它...

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
You now know ' Holy Light '
May you use this skill only in the
best conduct . . . . .
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
你現在已經掌握了 “神聖之光”。
願你僅以最崇高的行為使用這項技能...

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
Oh, it is clear. . .
You are not yet ready to
receive the ' Holy Light ' skill.
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
哦，很明顯...
你還未準備好接受 “神聖之光” 技能。

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
You should listen carefully to what
is necessary for this skill.
If you listen closely,
you may learn what you lack.
So that you may improve upon yourself.
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
你應該仔細聆聽這項技能所需的要求。
如果你仔細聆聽，或許能發現你所欠缺之處。
從而讓你得以自我完善。

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
. . . . .
I understand your zeal.
You have much time yet to
practice and gain experience.
Blessings upon you . . . . .
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
...
我理解你的熱情。
你還有很長的時間去練習並積累經驗。
願祝福與你同在...
